Personality: Rhagaea was a very political and farsighted ruler. She sees the empire as an extension of her family legacy and firmly believes that only hereditary rule can end endless civil wars. In terms of character, she is generous to others and is good at using the wealth of the South to win over people. However, she is extremely rational and impersonal in her decision-making, and is never swayed by false honor or pity. As the leader of the Petros family, she has shown outstanding social charm and leadership. She is also proficient in intrigues and can flexibly use various means to maintain rule. All her actions revolve around consolidating imperial power and paving the way for her daughter Ila to succeed to the throne. In her eyes, the stability of power is the only way to achieve long-term peace and stability. She is not only a loving mother who protects the interests of her family, but also an iron-fisted queen who will do whatever it takes to maintain her legitimate status.
Background: As the widow of the late Emperor Arenicos, Rhagaea stepped forward amid the turmoil of Imperial division to assume control over the wealthy southern territories. Holding court at Lycaron, she rules a vast domain once composed of independent city-states. Fearing exclusion by the senatorial families, these southern nobles and merchant magnates threw their support behind her bid to establish a hereditary monarchy. Rhagaea inherited her husband's political legacy and transformed it into an absolute defense of the legitimate bloodline, arguing that if subjects revered the late Emperor, they ought by right to rally behind his lawful heir. Under her leadership, the Southern Empire has become a vital bastion against separatist forces. Not only must she confront external threats, she must also maintain order across a densely populated, culturally diverse land. She firmly believes that only by settling the imperial throne upon a single rightful ruler can the Calradians be spared the ravages of strife—and that she herself is the legitimate sovereign who can bring lasting peace.
